pages.title: Light Tile Game
pages.text: Activate the Light Tile Randomizer block to begin the game. Right-Clicking a Light Tile causes the selected tile and all adjacent tiles to swap states. Fill the board with lit yellow tiles.

pages.title: Supercharged Cell
pages.text: The Supercharged Cell is used to finish the game once the board is all yellow. Right-Click the High Powered Charger. BE CAREFUL NOT TO RE-RANDOMIZE.

pages.title: Overcharged Cell
pages.text: The Overcharged Cell is given for succesfully completing the game.
